info.title: Buildstash API
info.description: The Buildstash API. Manage applications, builds, releases, share links, distribution groups, portals and webhooks, and upload builds from CI/CD pipelines.

tags.name: Workspace
tags.description: Workspace details, members, labels, default streams and custom targets.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: Applications, and their members, streams, labels, platforms and custom targets.

tags.name: Releases
tags.description: Releases, grouping builds for a version of an application.

tags.name: Share Links
tags.description: Public share links for builds and releases.

tags.name: Distribution Groups
tags.description: Groups of testers that releases are distributed to.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Webhooks sent when events happen in an application.

get.description: Retrieve information about the workspace associated with the API key. No scope required.
List all members of the workspace. Requires `members:read` scope. Only available with workspace-level API keys; application-level keys should use `/applications/{application_id}/members`.
List all workspace-level labels. These are shared across all applications in the workspace. Requires `workspace:read` scope.

post.description: Create a workspace-level label, available to every application in the workspace. The name must not already be used by any label in the workspace (at workspace or application level). Requires a workspace API key with `workspace:create` scope.

name.description: Label name. Letters, numbers, spaces and `- _ : / \ @ #`, with no leading, trailing or double spaces.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. `#4f46e5`. Assigned randomly if left out.

get.description: Get a single workspace-level label by ID or name. Requires `workspace:read` scope.
List the workspace's default stream templates. These templates are copied into new applications when they are created. Requires `workspace:read` scope.
List all workspace-level custom targets. These are shared across all applications in the workspace that use the target's platform. Requires `workspace:read` scope.

data.description: Builds distributed via Samsung Galaxy Store

post.description: Create a workspace-level custom target, available to every application with the target's platform. Requires a plan that includes custom targets, and a workspace API key with `workspace:create` scope.

get.description: Get a single workspace-level custom target by ID or name. Requires `workspace:read` scope.

data.name: Samsung Galaxy Store
data.description: Builds distributed via Samsung Galaxy Store

get.description: Get basic information about a workspace member. Requires `members:read` scope (with a workspace or application API key), and the user must be a member of the API key's workspace.

post.description: Initiate a build file upload by requesting presigned URLs. Requires `builds:create` scope.

application_id.description: Application ID. Required when using a Workspace API key.

structure.description: Upload structure type. Use 'file' unless including an Android OBB expansion file.

platform.description: Platform identifier. Must match an enabled platform slug. See [Platforms](/api/data/platforms) for the full list.

custom_target.description: Custom target for this build. Must exactly match the name of a target you've defined.

stream.description: Stream name. Must match exact name setup in your app.

source.description: Source of the upload. See [Build Sources](/api/data/sources#build-sources) for valid identifiers.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes. Can't be more than your plan's maximum build size (up to 50 GB).
Size of the expansion file in bytes (max 5GB).

expansion_files.description: Expansion files (only include if structure is 'file+expansion').

version_component_3_patch.description: Patch version component. At least one version component must be greater than zero.

version_component_meta.description: Optional metadata such as build number or commit hash

custom_build_number.description: Custom build number. Alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, and hyphens only.

labels.description: Labels for the build (will be created if they do not already exist). Each label name may be up to 25 characters.

items.description: Architecture identifier. The platform must also support the architecture. See [Architectures](/api/data/architectures) for the full list.

architectures.description: Architectures this build supports (the platform must also support the architecture). See [Architectures](/api/data/architectures) for the full list.

ci_run_id.description: CI run ID (numeric, up to 30 digits).

vc_host_type.description: Version control host type. `scm_host_type` is accepted as an alias. See [SCM Host Types](/api/data/sources#scm-host-types) for valid identifiers.

vc_host.description: Version control host. `scm_host` is accepted as an alias. See [SCM Sources](/api/data/sources#scm-sources) for valid identifiers.

415.description: The request isn't JSON, the build is too big for your plan or there isn't enough storage left, or the primary file's filetype isn't supported on the platform. If the filetype is supported on other platforms, the message says so and links to the [filetypes list](/api/data/filetypes).

value.message: Primary file filetype is not supported on the Generic platform. See the list of platforms which support .apk builds at https://docs.buildstash.com/api/data/filetypes
Primary file was not a supported filetype.
This build is too big for your plan. Upgrade your plan to upload

post.description: Request a presigned URL for the next chunk of a multipart upload. Requires `builds:create` scope.

content_length.description: Size in bytes of the part being uploaded.

post.description: Verify that an upload completed, and finalize the build. Safe to retry: verifying an upload that's already been verified (or is processing) returns the same success response without redoing anything. Uploads that were cancelled, failed, or weren't verified within 48 hours can't be verified (`400`). Requires `builds:create` scope.

multipart_chunks.description: Required for multipart uploads over 5GB, or when completing a multipart upload.

x-amz-checksum-crc64nvme.description: Optional CRC64NVME checksum header value from the S3 upload response.

409.description: Another request is verifying this upload at the same time

message.example: Verification of this upload is already in progress.

example.message: Verification of this upload is already in progress.

post.description: Abort an in-progress upload. Requires `builds:create` scope.

message.example: Unable to cancel upload as it is currently being verified.

example.message: Unable to cancel upload as it is currently being verified.

get.description: Get the status of an upload - in particular, to follow a build through processing after `/upload/verify` returns `pending_processing: true`. `percentage_processed` shows progress; if it stops changing for longer than `stall_timeout_seconds`, processing has most likely failed. Uploads not verified within 48 hours, and processing that doesn't finish, are reported as `failed`. Requires `builds:read` scope.

stall_timeout_seconds.description: How long progress can go without changing before processing should be treated as failed.

failure_reason.description: Why the upload failed, if it did.

invalid_platform_build.description: Whether the build was accepted but couldn't be parsed as a valid package for its platform.

build.description: The build, once the upload is `complete`.

post.description: Request a presigned URL to upload a metadata artifact for a build. Requires `builds:create` scope.

application_id.description: Application ID. Required when using a Workspace API key.

build_id.description: Build ID. Required if `primary_pending_upload_id` is not provided.

primary_pending_upload_id.description: Pending upload ID from `/upload/request`. Required if `build_id` is not provided.

filename.description: Metadata filename with extension. Filetype must be supported for the build platform. See [Metadata Filetypes](/api/data/metadata-filetypes).

size_bytes.description: Size of the metadata file in bytes (max 20MB; lower limits may apply per filetype).

schema.description: Request a presigned URL for a metadata artifact. Provide either `build_id` or `primary_pending_upload_id`.

example.message: Temporary presigned URL generated for metadata artifact upload.

post.description: Verify that a metadata artifact upload completed successfully. Requires `builds:create` scope.

pending_upload_id.description: Pending metadata upload ID returned from `/upload/metadata/request`.

file_description.description: Optional description for the metadata artifact.

x-amz-checksum-crc64nvme.description: Optional CRC64NVME checksum header value from the S3 upload response.

get.description: List the workspace's applications. Requires a workspace API key with `applications:read` scope - an application API key can't list applications, but can get its own with [Get application](/api/endpoint/applications/get-application).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Filter by platform slug. Returns 422 if the platform does not exist. See [Platforms](/api/data/platforms) for valid identifiers.

post.description: Create an application, with the given platforms attached. Default streams are created from the workspace's default streams (or `default`, `nightlies`, `stable` and `tests` if it has none). Requires a workspace API key with `applications:create` scope, and a plan with room for another application.

name.description: Must be unique within the workspace.

get.description: Retrieve a specific application. Requires `applications:read` scope with a workspace API key, or `application:read` scope with an application API key (for its own application only).

patch.description: Update an application. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Requires `applications:write` scope with a workspace API key, or `application:write` scope with an application API key (for its own application only).

name.description: Must be unique within the workspace.

delete.description: Delete an application, along with all its builds, releases and other data. Deletion completes in the background. Requires a workspace API key with `applications:write` scope.

get.description: List members with their resolved roles for the application. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `members:read` (application key) scope.

put.description: Set a workspace member's role in an application. Workspace owners and admins are always admins of every application, so the returned `role` is their effective role. Requires `applications:write` (workspace keys) or `members:write` scope. Application keys can only manage roles on their own application.

get.description: List all active streams for an application. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `application:read` (application key) scope.

post.description: Create a stream in an application. Requires `applications:write` (workspace keys) or `application:write` (application keys) scope.

name.description: Letters, numbers, `_`, `-` and `+`. Must be unique within the application.

retention_days.description: Days to keep builds in the stream before they're deleted. `null` keeps builds indefinitely.

get.description: Get a single application stream by ID or name. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `application:read` (application key) scope.

patch.description: Update a stream. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Reducing `retention_days` re-evaluates the stream's builds against the new policy. Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

name.description: Letters, numbers, `_`, `-` and `+`. Must be unique within the application.

retention_days.description: Days to keep builds in the stream before they're deleted. `null` keeps builds indefinitely.

delete.description: Delete a stream. If it has builds, either move them to another stream (`reassign_to_stream`) or delete them (`delete_builds`). Deletion completes in the background. An application's last stream can't be deleted. Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

reassign_to_stream.description: ID or name of the stream to move the builds to. Can't be the stream being deleted, or a stream that's being deleted.

delete_builds.description: Delete the stream's builds. Can't be combined with `reassign_to_stream`.

get.description: List the labels you can use on an application's builds and releases: the application's own labels, and workspace labels. Requires `application:read` with an application key, or `applications:read` or `workspace:read` with a workspace key.

post.description: Create an application-level label. The name must not already be used by a workspace-level label, or another label in this application. Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

name.description: Label name. Letters, numbers, spaces and `- _ : / \ @ #`, with no leading, trailing or double spaces.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. `#4f46e5`. Assigned randomly if left out.

get.description: Get a label by ID or name. This can be one of the application's own labels, or a workspace label. Requires `application:read` with an application key, or `applications:read` or `workspace:read` with a workspace key.

404.description: Label not found for this application

patch.description: Update an application-level label. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Workspace-level labels can't be changed through this endpoint (`403`). Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

name.description: Label name. Letters, numbers, spaces and `- _ : / \ @ #`, with no leading, trailing or double spaces.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. `#4f46e5`. Can't be cleared once set.

delete.description: Delete an application-level label, removing it from any builds and releases, and deleting any automations (webhooks, Slack or email notifications) that filter on it. Workspace-level labels can't be deleted through this endpoint (`403`). Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

get.description: List platforms attached to the application. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `application:read` (application key) scope.

post.description: Attach platforms to an application. Platforms already attached are ignored. An application can have up to 15 platforms. Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

200.description: Platforms added. Returns all the application's platforms.

delete.description: Remove a platform from an application. A platform can't be removed if the application has builds for it, or if it's the application's only platform (`422`). Requires `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

get.description: List all custom targets available for this application, including both workspace-level and application-level targets for platforms attached to the app. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `application:read` (application key) scope.

data.name: Samsung Galaxy Store
data.description: Builds distributed via Samsung Galaxy Store

post.description: Create an application-level custom target. The platform must be attached to the application. Requires a plan that includes custom targets, and `applications:write` or `application:write` scope.

get.description: Get a single custom target available to the application by ID or name. Includes both workspace-level and application-level targets. Requires `applications:read` (workspace key) or `application:read` (application key) scope.

data.name: Samsung Galaxy Store
data.description: Builds distributed via Samsung Galaxy Store

404.description: Custom target not found for this application

get.description: List all non-pending builds for an application with filtering and sorting. Requires `builds:read` scope.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by field. `version` sorts by full semantic version, `version_short` sorts by core version (major.minor.patch).

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Filter by platform slugs. Accepts a single slug or comma-separated list (e.g. `ios`, `android,ios`). Returns 422 if any slug is invalid. See [Platforms](/api/data/platforms) for valid platform slugs. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: streams
parameters.description: Filter by stream ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Returns 422 if any identifier is invalid for this application. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Filter by label ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Returns 422 if any identifier is invalid for this application. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: custom_targets
parameters.description: Filter by custom target ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Scoped to targets available to this application (workspace-level and application-level). If the workspace plan does not include custom target access, this filter is ignored and a note is included in the response message. Returns 422 if any identifier is invalid. Up to 20 values.

200.description: Builds retrieved. Note: `application_id` and `workspace_id` are omitted from build objects in list responses.

message.example: The platform identifier android2 is invalid.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific build. Includes `ios_info`, `android_info`, `primary_file`, `expansion_files`, and `metadata_artifacts` when available. Requires `builds:read` scope. Builds still uploading or processing can also be retrieved - check `upload_status` to see where they're at.

patch.description: Update a build's notes. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

delete.description: Delete a build. It's removed straight away, and its files are permanently deleted after 7 days. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

get.description: Get temporary presigned download URLs for a build's files. Includes expansion files and universal APK when available. Requires `builds:read` scope.

expansion_files.description: Present only when the build has expansion files.

universal_apk.description: Present only for Android builds that have a universal APK.

get.description: List all metadata artifacts attached to a build. Requires `builds:read` scope.
Get details of a single metadata artifact attached to a build. Requires `builds:read` scope.
Get a temporary presigned download URL for a specific metadata artifact. Requires `builds:read` scope.

message.example: Successfully retrieved temporary download URL for metadata artifact.

example.message: Successfully retrieved temporary download URL for metadata artifact.

get.description: List all releases for an application with filtering and sorting. Requires `releases:read` scope.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by field. `version` sorts by full semantic version, `version_short` sorts by core version (major.minor.patch).

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Filter by label ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Returns 422 if any identifier is invalid. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Filter by platform slugs. Accepts a single slug or comma-separated list. Returns releases containing builds on those platforms. Returns 422 if any slug is invalid. See [Platforms](/api/data/platforms) for valid platform slugs. Up to 20 values.

200.description: Releases retrieved. In list responses, `notes`, `application_id`, and `workspace_id` are omitted.

post.description: Create a release containing one or more builds. At least one version component must be greater than zero. The release's builds are protected from retention-driven deletion. Requires `releases:create` scope.

version_component_extra.description: Pre-release identifier, e.g. `beta.1`. Letters, numbers and hyphens, separated by dots.

version_component_meta.description: Build metadata. Letters, numbers and hyphens, separated by dots.

build_ids.description: IDs of completed builds in this application to include in the release.

version_component_extra.description: Pre-release identifier, e.g. `beta.1`. Letters, numbers and hyphens, separated by dots.

version_component_meta.description: Build metadata. Letters, numbers and hyphens, separated by dots.

delete.description: Delete a release. Its builds aren't deleted. Requires `releases:write` scope.

get.description: List all webhooks for an application. Requires `webhooks:read` scope.

post.description: Create a webhook for an application. Maximum 10 webhooks per application. The description must be unique within the application, and a webhook sending the same event (for the same stream or label) to the same URL is rejected as a duplicate. Webhooks are sent as JSON. Requires `webhooks:create` scope.

description.description: Must be unique within the application.
description.example: Notify CI when a build lands in nightlies

url.description: Must be a public HTTP/HTTPS URL. Localhost, private IPs, and reserved hosts are rejected.

event.description: Event type to subscribe to. `stream` is required for stream events (build.created.stream, build.moved.stream). `label` is required for build.label.added.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Minimum 32 characters with sufficient entropy. Stored encrypted.

stream.description: Stream ID or name. Required when event is build.created.stream or build.moved.stream. Must belong to the application.

label.description: Label ID or name. Required when event is build.label.added. Must be an application-level label for this app, or a workspace-level label.

example.description: Notify CI when a build lands in nightlies

data.description: Notify CI when a build lands in nightlies

get.description: Get a webhook for an application. Requires `webhooks:read` scope.

patch.description: Update a webhook. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. `stream` and `label` accept a stream/label ID or name, and are only applied when the webhook's event uses them. The update is rejected if it would duplicate another webhook. Requires `webhooks:write` scope.

description.description: Must be unique within the application.

url.description: Must be a public HTTP/HTTPS URL.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Minimum 32 characters with sufficient entropy. Stored encrypted.

stream.description: Stream ID or name. Used when the webhook event is build.created.stream or build.moved.stream. Ignored for other events. Must belong to the application.

label.description: Label ID or name. Used when the webhook event is build.label.added. Ignored for other events. Must be an application-level label for this app, or a workspace-level label.

data.description: Notify CI when a build lands in nightlies

get.description: List delivery history for a webhook. Requires `webhooks:read` scope.
Get the most recent delivery attempt for a webhook. Requires `webhooks:read` scope.

post.description: Send a test event to a webhook. The webhook must be active (`400` otherwise). Limited to 5 requests per minute. Requires `webhooks:write` scope.

put.description: Move a build to another stream in the application. Triggers `build.moved` and `build.moved.stream` automations, and re-evaluates the build against the new stream's retention policy. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

stream.description: Stream ID or name. Can't be a stream that's being deleted.

put.description: Replace all the labels on a build. Send an empty array to remove all labels. Triggers `build.label.added` automations for labels newly added. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

labels.description: Label IDs or names, as an array or comma-separated string. Labels must be workspace-level, or application-level labels in this application.

message.example: Build labels updated successfully. This replaces all labels on the build.

example.message: Build labels updated successfully. This replaces all labels on the build.

post.description: Add labels to a build, keeping its existing labels. Triggers `build.label.added` automations for labels newly added. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

labels.description: Label IDs or names, as an array or comma-separated string. Labels must be workspace-level, or application-level labels in this application.

post.description: Remove labels from a build. Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

labels.description: Label IDs or names, as an array or comma-separated string. Labels must be workspace-level, or application-level labels in this application.

put.description: Replace all the architectures a build supports. Send an empty array to remove all architectures. Not available for platforms that don't use architectures (`422`). Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

architectures.description: Architecture identifiers, as an array or comma-separated string. Each must be supported by the build's platform. See [Architectures](/api/data/architectures).

message.example: Build architectures updated successfully. This replaces all architectures on the build.

example.message: Build architectures updated successfully. This replaces all architectures on the build.

post.description: Add architectures to a build, keeping its existing architectures. Not available for platforms that don't use architectures (`422`). Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

architectures.description: Architecture identifiers, as an array or comma-separated string. Each must be supported by the build's platform. See [Architectures](/api/data/architectures).

post.description: Remove architectures from a build. Not available for platforms that don't use architectures (`422`). Builds still uploading or processing can't be changed (`404`). Requires `builds:write` scope.

architectures.description: Architecture identifiers, as an array or comma-separated string. Each must be supported by the build's platform. See [Architectures](/api/data/architectures).

get.description: List the builds in a release, newest first. Requires `builds:read` scope.

post.description: Add builds to a release. A release can have up to 100 builds. Added builds are protected from retention-driven deletion, and `release.updated` automations are notified. Requires `releases:write` scope.

build_ids.description: IDs of completed builds in this application.

post.description: Remove builds from a release. A release must keep at least one build (`422`). `release.updated` automations are notified. Requires `releases:write` scope.

build_ids.description: IDs of completed builds in this application.

post.description: Add labels to a release, keeping its existing labels. Requires `releases:write` scope.

labels.description: Label IDs or names, as an array or comma-separated string. Labels must be workspace-level, or application-level labels in this application.

get.description: List the share links for a build. Requires `share_links:read` scope.

delete.description: Delete a share link for a build. Requires `share_links:write` scope.

get.description: List the share links for a release. Requires `share_links:read` scope.

delete.description: Delete a share link for a release. Requires `share_links:write` scope.

get.description: List the workspace's distribution groups, newest first, with counts of their testers and releases (list them with the group's members and releases endpoints). Requires `distribution_groups:read` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

post.description: Create a distribution group. Requires a plan with room for another distribution group, and `distribution_groups:create` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

get.description: Get a distribution group, with counts of its testers and releases (list them with the group's members and releases endpoints). Requires `distribution_groups:read` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

patch.description: Update a distribution group. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Requires `distribution_groups:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

delete.description: Delete a distribution group. Requires `distribution_groups:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

get.description: List a distribution group's testers. `id` is the tester's user ID if they have a Buildstash account, otherwise `null`. Requires `distribution_groups:read` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

List the releases shared with a distribution group, newest first. With `group_by=application`, returns a summary of the releases per application instead. Requires `distribution_groups:read` and `releases:read` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

data.title: Initial Release
data.notes:
## What's new

- First public release
- Bug fixes and improvements

post.description: Share up to 10 releases with a distribution group, optionally emailing its testers. When emailing, each tester gets one email per application: several releases of the same application are covered by a single email linking to the newest, and testers aren't emailed again about releases they've already been notified of. Requires `distribution_groups:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

release_ids.description: IDs of releases in the workspace.

send_email.description: Email the group's testers about the releases (one email per application).

post.description: Stop sharing releases with a distribution group. Testers lose access to the releases through this group. Requires `distribution_groups:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

release_ids.description: IDs of releases in the workspace.

get.description: List the workspace's portals, newest first. Requires `portals:read` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.
Get a portal. Requires `portals:read` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

patch.description: Update a portal's name and description. Only the fields provided are changed - a field sent as `null` is cleared, and fields left out are unchanged. `PUT` is also accepted, with the same behaviour. Requires `portals:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

name.description: Must be unique within the workspace.

delete.description: Delete a portal, including any custom domain. Requires `portals:write` scope. Only available with workspace API keys.

get.description: List the applications linked to a portal. Requires `portals:read` and `applications:read` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

message.example: Application attached to portal retrieved successfully.

example.message: Application attached to portal retrieved successfully.

get.description: List an application's builds published on a portal - all its builds, or those in streams published on the portal, depending on the portal's settings. Returns no builds if the portal doesn't publish builds for the application. The application must be linked to the portal (`404` otherwise). Requires `portals:read` and `builds:read` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Filter by platform identifiers. Accepts a single identifier or comma-separated list. Returns 422 if any is invalid. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: streams
parameters.description: Filter by stream ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Up to 20 values.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Filter by label ID or name. Accepts a single value or comma-separated list. Up to 20 values.

get.description: Get a build published on a portal - either directly (by the portal's build settings), or as part of a release published on the portal. `404` if the build isn't published there. The application must be linked to the portal (`404` otherwise). Requires `portals:read` and `builds:read` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

List an application's releases published on a portal - all its releases, or only those published to the portal, depending on the portal's settings. Returns no releases if the portal doesn't publish releases for the application. The application must be linked to the portal (`404` otherwise). Requires `portals:read` and `releases:read` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

post.description: Publish a release on a portal. The release's application must be linked to the portal (`404`), and the portal must publish releases for it (`422`). Requires `portals:write` and `releases:write` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

delete.description: Stop publishing a release on a portal. The release itself isn't deleted. Requires `portals:write` and `releases:write` scopes. Only available with workspace API keys.

Build.description: A build. In list responses, `application_id` and `workspace_id` are omitted. Sub-resources like `primary_file`, `expansion_files`, `metadata_artifacts`, `ios_info`, and `android_info` are only included when fetching a single build.

primary_file.description: Only included when fetching a single build.

expansion_files.description: Only included when fetching a single build.

metadata_artifacts.description: Only included when fetching a single build.

ios_info.description: iOS-specific build info. Only included when fetching a single build.

android_info.description: Android-specific build info. Only included when fetching a single build.

pending.description: Whether the build is still uploading or processing. Use `upload_status` for more detail.

modal_url.description: Direct URL to the build detail page in the web app.

download_url.description: URL to initiate a build download via the web app.

upload_status.description: Where the build is in the upload process. `pending` and `processing` are in progress; `complete`, `failed` and `cancelled` are final. Uploads not verified within 48 hours, and processing that doesn't finish, are reported as `failed`.

upload_status_reason.description: Why the upload failed or was cancelled. `null` otherwise.

invalid_platform_build.description: Whether the build was accepted but couldn't be parsed as a valid package for its platform.

invalid_platform_build_reason.description: Why the build isn't a valid package for its platform, if `invalid_platform_build` is `true`.

notes.description: Markdown release notes. Only included when retrieving a single release, not in list views.

build_count.description: Number of builds in the release. Only included when listing releases.

builds.description: Full build objects. Only included when retrieving a single release, not in list views.
